prompt: A realistic still blended as a double exposure, like a 1960s spy-film title sequence: inside the silhouette of the main figure there is a second image of banknotes whirling up through flames in burning amber and red. Camera low at the height of the firebox, fresh banknotes scattered on the stone floor in the foreground. In a hidden 1920s basement print room, a huge cast-iron printing press throws sheets of banknotes into the air. Beside it a tall skinny man in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache, shovels coal into the press's red-hot firebox, grinning. Behind him an exhausted stoker in a soot-black vest sits slumped against the brick wall. Riveted pipes, brass gauges, steam. Outside the silhouette, deep black shadow broken by hard gold light. The face nearest the camera stays realistic and readable. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
